_doc: Tuning knobs for the scheduled Routine (routine-prompt.md), read by tools/next_mode.py. 'weights' are the long-run share of runs per mode; a deterministic debt scheduler replays metrics/history.jsonl so no state file is needed and overlapping runs cannot conflict. Triggers: lint is forced when 'lint_every_runs' runs have passed without one; originality is forced every 'originality_every_runs' runs; site is forced when the last recorded site build failed; build is blocked when the draft ceiling is reached or the day's remaining budget cannot pay for the panel; closure is suppressed when the queue has no closure candidates; review is suppressed when nothing needs a second reading. Founding values, 2026-09-16.
